evidence: JD: "Core collaboration hours are 13:00–16:00 Europe/Zurich."
Preference: "I prefer core meetings to finish by 17:00 Europe/Zurich."

findings.proposed_fix: If the intended gold is aligned, change the fictional JD source to state that required core meetings finish by 16:00 and update all literal citations. Otherwise mark this preference unknown, explain the gap, and adjust the positive answers.

evidence: Answer 03 labels salary aligned because negotiation supposedly guarantees CHF 160,000.
